paragraphs.source_en: That day the sky was high and nearly cloudless. At the head of the procession, twelve great hawks presented by Ujimasa stirred in the morning wind. Yet compared with the gifts Ieyasu had brought, these were far inferior; the measure of the Hōjō could be discerned from that alone.
